could_not_read_redacted: could not be read; the daemon log has the error

log.step_failed: onboarding step {step} could not be read: {err}

identity.title: Identity provider
identity.effect: the dashboard has no login; anyone who reaches the port is owner
identity.finish: set OCTOPUS_OIDC_* and restart, or rerun the wizard
identity.dev_mode: dev mode: auth disabled — anyone who reaches the port is owner
identity.none: none configured — API keys are the only way in

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.effect: nothing can be created: every resource and every API key belongs to one

agents.title: Agent definitions
agents.effect: the board has no agents to dispatch to
agents.finish: create one on the Agents page, or import a JSON file from Workshop → Import file

git_credential.title: Git credential
git_credential.effect: agents can read public repos only — no branches, no pull requests
git_credential.finish: add a GitHub token on the credentials page
git_credential.app_not_installed: App configured, not installed on any account yet
git_credential.install_app: install the App from the credentials page

llm_key.title: Model key (BYOK)
llm_key.effect: agent runs fail at dispatch: there is no model to call
llm_key.finish: set the engine's default profile in Settings → AI engines
llm_key.no_key_personal: no key for {engine}. Until there is one, the runs you start yourself can use your own account: Settings → AI engines → Your own account

project.title: First project
project.effect: there is no repository for agents to work in
project.finish: import a git repo on the projects page

column_agent.title: A column that runs an agent
column_agent.effect: moving a card launches nothing: no column of the board has a default agent
column_agent.finish: open a column's Behavior in the board settings and pick its default agent
column_agent.none: no column of the default board has a default agent

stage_template.title: Agents in each project's template
stage_template.effect: tasks of a project with an empty stage template start with no agent in any column
stage_template.finish: pick the agent of each column in the project's Settings → Stage template
stage_template.count: {with} of {count} projects have an agent in some column
